question: Why isn't my collection day showing correctly?
answer: Wasteful doesn't pull live data from your council — you enter your own schedule based on what your council tells you. If your council changes your collection day, you'll need to update your schedule in Manage Address and Schedule.

question: What does "evening before" mean for reminders?
answer: By default, reminders fire the evening before your collection day at a time you set in Settings. You can also switch to "morning of" reminders, or set a custom time for any individual schedule.

question: Can I track more than one address?
answer: Yes. Add as many addresses as you need from the Address dropdown when creating a schedule, or manage them all under Manage Address and Schedule in Settings.

question: My council isn't in the search list — what do I do?
answer: Search "bin collection days" plus your area name to find your council's page, then set up your schedule manually using Add Schedule.

question: Is my data shared with my council or anyone else?
answer: No. Your addresses and schedules are stored only on your device. Find My Council only opens your council's own website in your browser — nothing is sent anywhere.
